name: image-expression-grid
title: Expression Grid
description: Nine-frame contact sheet of a single subject reacting

subject.descent: Not asserted — synthetic subject; specify explicitly when recreating.
subject.physical: Same fair-haired figure across nine frames, hair and framing consistent, only the face changing
subject.expression: Full range — laughing, surprised, pouting, deadpan, heart-hands
subject.clothing: Light denim jacket over a white top, consistent across all nine

framing.subjectScale: Nine equal cells; head fills ~60% of each cell width
framing.subjectBox: Three-by-three grid, boundaries at 33% and 67% on both axes; head centred per cell
framing.anchors: Eyeline at roughly 35% of each cell height, consistent across all nine
framing.edges: Shoulders crop at each cell bottom edge; no bleed between cells
framing.negativeSpace: Small uniform margin inside each cell; no outer margin

environment.background: Flat pale backdrop, identical in every frame

atmosphere.story: One performer running through their expressions for a casting file.
atmosphere.micro: The point is the variation — keep each frame distinct
